subject: Close cadence and MAP security gating — SOC 2 runbook & DPA retention carveouts
messages:
From: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@crestline.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Daniel Harris <dharris@crestline.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@crestline.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP close cadence + security gate specifics (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Crestline's procurement and InfoSec teams reviewed the shared MAP and want to lock down the security gating so we can finalize the commercial terms. A few items to reconcile before we send to legal: 

- SOC 2: we need to confirm the exact scope (Type II, infrastructure + controls). Are you able to share the evidence index and cadence for evidence handoff (we'll need an owner and timeline for the 30-day readout)?
- SIG/CAIQ: we'll do the CAIQ baseline; any carveouts we should expect?
- DPA & data retention: our records team requires a clear retention window per data class (PII, logs, backups) and an export/destruction plan tied to contract termination.

Can you propose a revised close cadence that ties MAP milestones to the security gates (SOC2 readout, CAIQ submission, and DPA signoff)? If possible, include a short list of items we can send to our legal team to expedite the DPA redline.

Appreciate it — Samantha

-----

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Samantha Wu <samantha.wu@crestline.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jul 2029 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP close cadence + security gate specifics (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (sales lead) and Kimberly (security & contracts) to align on timelines. High level proposal attached (redwood_map_v2.pdf) and SOC 2 evidence index (SOC2_evidence_index.xlsx). Quick summary below: 

Proposed close cadence (4-week sprint):
1) Week 1 — MAP finalization & DPA redline: Redwood to deliver DPA redline + tractable retention table. You to return any counterpoints within 5 business days.
2) Week 2 — SIG/CAIQ submission & CAIQ Q/A: Redwood submits CAIQ baseline; Crestline to highlight any carveout requests.
3) Week 3 — SOC 2 readiness snapshot: we’ll provide an evidence index and 30-day readout owner (Kimberly) with targeted artifacts for your reviewers.
4) Week 4 — Legal signoff & DocuSign circulation.

Retention summary (excerpt):
- PII (end-user content): default retention 90 days; optional extension to 12 months on request with export plan.
- Operational logs (debug/trace): 90 days rolling; 365 days archived for compliance customers.
- Backups: 90 days immutable; immutable snapshot for longer retention negotiable (escrow/SLAs).

Attachments: DPA redline draft attached for your legal (DPA_redline_crestline.docx). Ben, can you confirm if a 4-week sprint aligns with our commercial close target? Kimberly — can you own the SOC 2 evidence handoff?

Best,
Marissa
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

-----

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2029 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP close cadence + security gate specifics (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Marissa / Kimberly — quick thumbs up from the commercial side: 4-week sprint is aggressive but doable if Crestline returns the DPA redline in week 1 and legal timeboxes are respected. A couple of negotiation points we should proactively include in the DPA to avoid last-minute stalls:

- Escape hatch for retention extension requests (process + cost buckets) so the legal ops team can accept operational burden without indefinite exposure.
- Clarify subprocessors (we list cloud infra partners) and provide KMS/HSM options for customer-managed keys as an enterprise add-on.
- SLA carveouts if they require EU residency in a different region (we can provide private deployment options but that affects lead times).

I'll draft a short bullet list for legal now and upload to the shared doc. Kimberly — if you can prepare a 2-page SOC 2 snapshot with owner contact and artifact examples, that should satisfy their security reviewers for Week 3.

Ben Carter
Senior Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

-----

From: Daniel Harris <dharris@crestline.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2029 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP close cadence + security gate specifics (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Thanks — this looks actionable. We're OK to try the 4-week sprint provided Kimberly's SOC 2 snapshot and the DPA redline land by end of day Wednesday (24 Jul). Two quick asks from legal: 

1) Please include the retention table in the DPA as a separate annex (so our legal can accept the annex faster than reopening the core DPA).
2) If Redwood anticipates any CAIQ carveouts, list them explicitly in the CAIQ submission (we need to assess residual risk).

We will route the DPA to our legal on receipt and aim to return redlines within 3 business days. When you're ready, please share the DocuSign link for the final DPA.

Regards,
Daniel Harris
Head of Legal Ops, Crestline Financial

-----

[Attachments referenced: redwood_map_v2.pdf (MAP draft), SOC2_evidence_index.xlsx (index of artifacts), DPA_redline_crestline.docx (initial redline)]
